Sweet & Savory Bacon Wrapped Smokies
By: Kaitlin Phillips
Published: Sunday, February 28, 2010 - 4:46pm

Ingredients




16 ounces Package of Little Smokies
1 pound Bacon
3/4 cup Brown Sugar
Toothpicks

Preparation

1 Cut each bacon strip into thirds, and wrap each third around a smokie and secure with a toothpick. Layer then evenly on a foil lined cookie sheet and then sprinkle with brown sugar. Bake in a pre-heated 325 degree oven for 40-45 minutes.

About


Good evening! I'm here with my first recipe for my super bowl week! In case you don't know what I'm talking about, each day this week (Monday-Sunday) I will be featuring a recipe that would be good for the big game. Up first are these bacon wrapped smokies. These are bite sized pieces of heaven! They are so delicious. The brown sugar after it bakes just takes them over the top. These are a new MUST for any get together I go to! I would definitely include these in your super bowl menu!!
-
